integrity: Arithmetic identities are checked by a standalone standard-library verifier and a separate symbolic calculation. Classical elliptic quotient and Cartier theorems are cited. Priority risk from specialized tables is disclosed. No independent scientific validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the marked smooth pencil y²=(x²−1)(x⁴−t), t≠0,1, in characteristic 17 is classified. Inversion identifies pairs of parameters geometrically. First-prime assertion is only among odd primes; integral isogeny and endomorphism rings are not determined.
title: A characteristic-seventeen superspecial intersection in a genus-two elliptic-quotient pencil
